decision: Can TensorLBM reproduce joconnor22/LIFE's regularised D2Q9 boundary condition (Latt et al. 2008) -- unknown in-flowing populations closed by non-equilibrium bounce-back, the node stress Pi_neq^{ab}=sum_q c_a c_b (f_q - f_q^eq) accumulated over the RECONSTRUCTED set and all populations then replaced by f^eq + (w_q/2c_s^4) Q_qab Pi_neq^{ab} -- within the owner 15% criterion, and does replacing the status-quo Zou-He open boundaries by it change (improve/degrade) the physical accuracy of a plane-Poiseuille channel?

reference.frozen_method_digest: src/Grid.cpp::regularisedBC L386-470 + getNormalVector L504-540 + Utils.h zeroGradient/extrapolate; transcribed to xval/XVAL-LBM-REG-BC-NEQ-STRESS/reference.py (independent code path: numpy, per-node loops, in-place update in BC-vector order)

alternatives.life_ref: numpy per-node transcription of LIFE regularisedBC (reference arm)
alternatives.tlbm_port: tensorlbm.regularised_bc_2d (new vectorised torch port, this mission)
alternatives.status_quo_zouhe: Zou-He velocity inlet + Zou-He pressure outlet + solid-node bounce-back walls (TensorLBM's current 2D practice)
alternatives.arm_reg_reg: regularised velocity inlet + regularised pressure outlet, regularised wet-node walls
alternatives.arm_zouhe: Zou-He inlet + Zou-He outlet, half-way bounce-back walls

hypothesis.H1: port and reference agree on the post-BC populations of every non-corner boundary node to <15% (expected machine precision): same formula, same accumulated stress.
hypothesis.H2: the two implementations differ measurably only at corner nodes, where LIFE updates rho in place in BC-vector order while the port gathers rho from the pre-BC field (order dependence).
hypothesis.H3: at equal collision kernel and equal effective channel height, the regularised open boundaries give a mid-channel profile error vs the analytic parabola comparable to (<15% gate) or better than Zou-He, and a smaller mass-flux drift and smaller spurious transverse velocity at the outlet.
hypothesis.falsifier: H1 falsified if any non-corner node exceeds 15% relative population deviation; H3 falsified if either arm exceeds the 15% owner gate on the profile error, or if the regularised arm is >15% worse than Zou-He on every metric.

metrics.K1_pop_rel_dev_pct: max over boundary nodes and 9 populations of |f_port - f_ref| / sqrt(mean_q f_ref^2) *100 at a converged snapshot, split corner vs non-corner
metrics.K2_invariants: |rho_after - rho_prescribed|, |u_after - u_prescribed| and |Pi_neq(f_after) - Pi_neq(f_before)| (must be ~machine eps: regularisation preserves rho, u and the six second moments)
metrics.K3_profile_err_pct: max_j |u_num(j) - u_exact(j)| / u_max * 100 at the mid-channel column
metrics.K4_field_l2_pct: sqrt(sum (u_num-u_exact)^2 / sum u_exact^2) * 100 over the whole domain
metrics.K6_outlet_uy_pct: max|uy| at the outlet column / u_max * 100 (spurious transverse velocity)
metrics.K7_wall_slip_pct: max|ux| on the wet wall node row / u_max * 100 (regularised-wall slip)

predeclared_thresholds.pass_rule: K1 < 15% for non-corner nodes (H1) and K3 < 15% for both channel arms (H3); K1 is reported per node class even if a corner disagreement is attributed
predeclared_thresholds.iteration_rule: runs are marched until max|u(t)-u(t-500)| < 1e-13 or the predeclared step cap; a run that does not reach the cap-free stationarity criterion is reported as NOT CONVERGED, never tuned
predeclared_thresholds.no_tuning_rule: u_max, Re, H, L, tau and the analytic reference are fixed before the first production run; no threshold or arm is changed after inspecting KPI values

reference_values.analytic_poiseuille: u(y) = 4 u_max y (H-y) / H^2, exact steady solution of the incompressible limit of the BGK lattice equation for a straight channel (parabolic inlet = exact solution, no body force)
reference_values.geometry_convention: reg arm: wet nodes at j=0 and j=Ny-1, H=Ny-1, y=j; zouhe arm: half-way bounce-back planes at j=0.5 and j=Ny-0.5, H=Ny-1, y=j-0.5 -> identical physical channel height in both arms

variables_controlled: BGK collision with identical code path
unit_of_analysis: one arm x one (H, Re) case; KPIs are scalars over a converged field
environment: CPU, python 3, torch 2.7.1 float64, numpy 2.4.6; commands recorded in run_xval.py --help and out/results.json
stopping_rule: stop at stationarity tolerance or 20000 (H=32) / 8000 (H=16) steps; a diverging arm (non-finite) is reported as measured
